evidence: 24.46% of owner-surrender visits (2016-2024) are animals whose previous visit ended in adoption at this shelter (8,065 returns in total); 61.69% occur within 30 days of the adoption.
key_limitation: Adoptions before 01-10-2013 are invisible; surrender reason is not recorded.

evidence: Full-year intake events averaged 18,216 (2014-2019) vs 11,643 (2022-2024); level shift begins 03-2020. Seasonal index peaks in month 5 (127.4) and troughs in month 2 (77.7).
key_limitation: Event counts only; cause of the 2020 break not established from data.

evidence: Adoption is 48.64% of matched visits. Dog adoptions re-enter within 365 days in 15.0% of cases.
key_limitation: Adoption subtype 'Foster' mixes foster-to-adopt with on-site adoption.

evidence: Dog median LOS 5.12 days (2014-2019 cohorts) vs 12.38 days (2023-2024). Excluding foster-subtype outcomes, dog visits over 30 days rose from 8.68% to 22.61%.
key_limitation: LOS depends on the matching rule and includes foster time for some outcomes; recent cohorts slightly censored.

evidence: Stray-dog visits ending in RTO fell from 29.46% (2014-2019 average) to 12.51% (2024).
key_limitation: Field returns that never create an intake are not in the data; a falling share may reflect a changed intake mix.

evidence: Estimated average daily in-care population (matched visits) was 1,120 in 2019 and 916 in 2024, while intake events fell from 19,726 to 11,815.
key_limitation: Census is an estimate from matched visits (foster time included); not an official kennel count.

evidence: Stray is the largest intake type (68.6% of intake rows). Found Location is free text (70k distinct values) so geographic analysis needs geocoding.
key_limitation: Location text quality limits spatial targeting.

evidence: Age text is coarse (N years) but parses for >99.99% of rows; LOS and outcome mix differ by life stage.
key_limitation: Age is estimated at intake for strays.

evidence: 10.06% of intake events are a repeat intake for the same Animal ID.
key_limitation: Depends on Animal ID persistence across visits.

evidence: 7,777 visits exceeded 90 days and 577 exceeded 365 days; 75.22% of 365+ day visits ended with a 'Foster' subtype.
key_limitation: Many very long stays are foster placements, not kennel stays.

evidence: Euthanasia is 6.22% of matched visits; 42.98% of euthanasia visits are 'Other' (wildlife) with subtype Rabies Risk. Dog/cat share 5.94% (2014 cohort) vs 2.36% (2024).
key_limitation: Highly sensitive; wildlife must be separated; not the official live-release rate.

evidence: 15.25% of matched visits had a non-'Normal' intake condition; 20 labels with overlapping meanings (e.g. Medical / Med Attn / Med Urgent).
key_limitation: Label set changes over time; severity not ordinal.

evidence: Transfer is 28.03% of matched visits; 27.42% of cat transfers are SNR/SCRP (community-cat return programmes), not partner placements.
key_limitation: 'Transfer' mixes partner placement and return-to-field; partner identity absent.

evidence: Died ~1% and Disposal ~0.5% of visits; Disposal is not defined in the extract.
3,006 distinct breed labels; 69% are mixes or slash combinations; only 41 labels have >=500 matched visits.
key_limitation: Visual breed identification is unreliable; high risk of stigmatising conclusions.
